commands.stdout:
#!/bin/sh
# Long-running inventory worker: periodically snapshots simple inventory data.
set -eu

DATA_DIR=/var/lib/inventory
LOG=/var/lib/inventory/worker.log

echo "$(date -Iseconds) inventory-worker starting pid=$$" >> "$LOG"

i=0
while true; do
    i=$((i + 1))
    ts="$(date -Iseconds)"
    {
        echo "timestamp=$ts"
        echo "sequence=$i"
        echo "uptime=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/uptime 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)"
    } > "$DATA_DIR/inventory-snapshot.txt"
    echo "$ts snapshot #$i written" >> "$LOG"
    sleep 10
done
